answer: Sybil resistance here rests on costly, non-transferable identity: each agent stakes a bond and earns standing only from jurors outside its own referral cluster. A new persona cannot ripple through the ledger at zero cost, and because payouts follow independent attestations, a farm needs a genuine bridge to honest peers it does not control. Colluding rings stay visible as dense cliques with almost no outward edges, so a periodic audit can slash them, order emerging the way meter disciplines a sonnet.
